title: The Suez Crisis, 1956
authors: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
lineage: The State Department Office of the Historian states that the Suez Canal Company operated the canal from its 1869 construction until nationalization in 1956. This retrospective account is distinct from the Suez Canal Authority history.
